verses.en: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these are the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.pt: Então vieram as filhas de Zelofeade, filho de Hefer, filho de Gileade, filho de Maquir, filho de Manassés, das famílias de Manassés, filho de José; e os nomes delas são estes: Macla, Noa, Hogla, Milca e Tirza;
verses.en_web: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.en_bbe: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh, the son of Joseph, came forward: their names are Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.

verses.en: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
verses.pt: apresentaram-se diante de Moisés, e de Eleazar, o sacerdote, e diante dos príncipes e de toda a congregação à porta da tenda da revelação, dizendo:
verses.en_web: They stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, at the door of the Tent of Meeting, saying,
verses.en_bbe: They came before Moses and Eleazar the priest and the chiefs and all the people at the door of the Tent of meeting, and said,

verses.en: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.
verses.pt: Nosso pai morreu no deserto, e não se achou na companhia daqueles que se ajuntaram contra o Senhor, isto é, na companhia de Corá; porém morreu no seu próprio pecado, e não teve filhos.
verses.en_web: “Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against Yahweh in the company of Korah, but he died in his own sin. He had no sons.
verses.en_bbe: Death overtook our father in the waste land; he was not among those who were banded together with Korah against the Lord; but death came to him in his sin; and he had no sons.

verses.en: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father.
verses.pt: Por que se tiraria o nome de nosso pai dentre a sua família, por não ter tido um filho? Dai-nos possessão entre os irmãos de nosso pai.
verses.en_web: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give to us a possession among the brothers of our father.”
verses.en_bbe: Why is the name of our father to be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give us a heritage among our father's brothers.

verses.en: And Moses brought their cause before the LORD.
verses.pt: Moisés, pois, levou a causa delas perante o Senhor.
verses.en_web: Moses brought their cause before Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: So Moses put their cause before the Lord.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.
verses.pt: O que as filhas de Zelofeade falam é justo; certamente lhes darás possessão de herança entre os irmãos de seu pai; a herança de seu pai farás passar a elas.
verses.en_web: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak right. You shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brothers. You shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.
verses.en_bbe: What the daughters of Zelophehad say is right: certainly you are to give them a heritage among their father's brothers: and let the property which would have been their father's go to them.

verses.en: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.
verses.pt: E dirás aos filhos de Israel: Se morrer um homem, e não tiver filho, fareis passar a sua herança à sua filha.
verses.en_web: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a man dies, and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.
verses.en_bbe: And say to the children of Israel, If a man has no son at the time of his death, let his heritage go to his daughter.

verses.en: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.
verses.pt: E, se não tiver filha, dareis a sua herança a seus irmãos.
verses.en_web: If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.
verses.en_bbe: And if he has no daughter, then give his heritage to his brothers.

verses.en: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father’s brethren.
verses.pt: Mas, se não tiver irmãos, dareis a sua herança aos irmãos de seu pai.
verses.en_web: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
verses.en_bbe: And if he has no brothers, then give his heritage to his father's brothers.

verses.en: And if his father have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.pt: Se também seu pai não tiver irmãos, então dareis a sua herança a seu parente mais chegado dentre a sua família, para que a possua; isto será para os filhos de Israel estatuto de direito, como o Senhor ordenou a Moisés.
verses.en_web: If his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his kinsman who is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it. This shall be a statute and ordinance for the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.’”
verses.en_bbe: And if his father has no brothers, then give it to his nearest relation in the family, as his heritage: this is to be a decision made by law for the children of Israel, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.
verses.pt: Depois disse o Senhor a Moisés: sobe a este monte de Abarim, e vê a terra que tenho dado aos filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses, Go up into this mountain of Abarim so that you may see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.

verses.en: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.
verses.pt: E, tendo-a visto, serás tu também recolhido ao teu povo, assim como o foi teu irmão Arão;
verses.en_web: When you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered;
verses.en_bbe: And when you have seen it, you will be put to rest with your people, as your brother Aaron was:

verses.en: For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that is the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
verses.pt: porquanto no deserto de Zim, na contenda da congregação, fostes rebeldes à minha palavra, não me santificando diante dos seus olhos, no tocante às águas (estas são as águas de Meribá de Cades, no deserto de Zim).
verses.en_web: because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)
verses.en_bbe: Because in the waste land of Zin, when the people were angry, you and he went against my word and did not keep my name holy before their eyes, at the waters. (These are the waters of Meribah in Kadesh in the waste land of Zin.)

verses.en: And Moses spake unto the LORD, saying,
verses.pt: Respondeu Moisés ao Senhor:
verses.en_web: Moses spoke to Yahweh, saying,
verses.en_bbe: Then Moses said to the Lord,

verses.en: Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,
verses.pt: Que o senhor, Deus dos espíritos de toda a carne, ponha um homem sobre a congregação,
verses.en_web: “Let Yahweh, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,
verses.en_bbe: Let the Lord, the God of the spirits of all flesh, put a man at the head of this people,

verses.en: Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the LORD be not as sheep which have no shepherd.
verses.pt: o qual saia diante deles e entre diante deles, e os faça sair e os faça entrar; para que a congregação do Senhor não seja como ovelhas que não têm pastor.
verses.en_web: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in; that the congregation of Yahweh may not be as sheep which have no shepherd.”
verses.en_bbe: To go out and come in before them and be their guide; so that the people of the Lord may not be like sheep without a keeper.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him;
verses.pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés: Toma a Josué, filho de Num, homem em quem há o Espírito, e impõe-lhe a mão;
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses, Take Joshua, the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and put your hand on him;

verses.en: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.
verses.pt: e apresenta-o perante Eleazar, o sacerdote, e perante toda a congregação, e dá-lhe a comissão à vista deles;
verses.en_web: Set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.
verses.en_bbe: And take him before Eleazar the priest and all the meeting of the people, and give him his orders before their eyes.

verses.en: And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.
verses.pt: e sobre ele porás da tua glória, para que lhe obedeça toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: You shall give authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.
verses.en_bbe: And put your honour on him, so that all the children of Israel may be under his authority.

verses.en: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the LORD: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.
verses.pt: Ele, pois, se apresentará perante Eleazar, o sacerdote, o qual por ele inquirirá segundo o juízo do Urim, perante o Senhor; segundo a ordem de Eleazar sairão, e segundo a ordem de Eleazar entrarão, ele e todos os filhos de Israel, isto é, toda a congregação.
verses.en_web: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before Yahweh. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.”
verses.en_bbe: He will take his place before Eleazar the priest, so that he may get directions from the Lord for him, with the Urim: at his word they will go out, and at his word they will come in, he and all the children of Israel.

verses.en: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:
verses.pt: Então Moisés fez como o Senhor lhe ordenara: tomou a Josué, apresentou-o perante Eleazar, o sacerdote, e perante toda a congregação,
verses.en_web: Moses did as Yahweh commanded him. He took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation.
verses.en_bbe: So Moses did as the Lord said: he took Joshua and put him before Eleazar the priest and the meeting of the people:

verses.en: And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
verses.pt: impôs-lhe as mãos, e lhe deu a comissão; como o Senhor falara por intermédio de Moisés.
verses.en_web: He laid his hands on him, and commissioned him, as Yahweh spoke by Moses.
verses.en_bbe: And he put his hands on him and gave him his orders, as the Lord had said by Moses.
